use_utf8.description: Use UTF-8 encoding for all text.

gap_x.description: Horizontal gap (in pixels) between Conky and screen edge.

gap_y.description: Vertical gap (in pixels) between Conky and screen edge.

minimum_width.description: Minimum width of Conky window in pixels.

minimum_height.description: Minimum height of Conky window in pixels.

background.description: Run Conky as a background daemon.

out_to_console.description: Output to standard output (console) instead of GUI window.

out_to_stderr.description: Send output errors to standard error.

extra_newline.description: Add an extra newline at the end of console output.

colors.description: Named color palette used in template_text.

default_color.description: Default color used when no color is specified.

update_interval.description: Refresh rate in seconds for UI updates.

text_buffer.description: Size of internal text buffer (in bytes).

max_user_text.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of user text sections.

text_size.description: Height (in pixels) of the Conky text area.

network_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to monitor.

disk_devices.description: List of mount points/disk devices to display disk usage.

cpu_avg_samples.description: Number of samples used to average CPU usage graphs.

time_format.description: strftime-compatible format string for time display.

top_name.description: Header label for process name in top sections.

top_exe.description: Header label for executable path in top sections.

top_mem.description: Header label for memory usage in top sections.

top_cpu.description: Header label for CPU usage in top sections.

top_io.description: Header label for I/O usage in top sections.

top_time.description: Header label for process runtime in top sections.

user_text_blocks.description: Array of custom text blocks inserted into config.

name.description: Variable name for the block (e.g., text_block1).

text.description: Literal text (can include Conky variables like ${cpu cpu0}).

body_text.description: Main multi-line Conky text body using Conky’s built-in variable syntax (e.g., ${...}).
